description: Curated official disclosures with explicit dates, limitations and evidence status. Rolling dashboard window may exclude historical records. Dates of advisories and notices are not necessarily intrusion dates.

records.title: Brazil National Treasury unauthorized access to personal data
records.summary: The National Treasury disclosed unauthorized access to approximately 30,000 e-Servicos registrations and an analytical database with approximately 4,000 PIX keys. The agency reported containment, additional safeguards and an ongoing technical investigation; it stated no financial impact or compromise of core systems.

sources.name: Brazil Ministry of Finance official incident notice, 13 November 2026

records.limitations: Official self-report; incident origin, full extent and independent verification of remediation remain unresolved.

records.title: CAPES Meus Dados platform unauthorized access
records.summary: CAPES disclosed a security incident permitting unauthorized access to personal data on the Meus Dados platform. Potentially accessible fields include CPF, contact details and bank data. CAPES reported restricting affected functionality and reviewing authorization controls while technical investigation continues.

sources.name: Official CAPES statement republished by IPEN, updated 9 November 2026

records.limitations: Official statement identifies possible data exposure; number of affected individuals and independently verified remediation are not established.

records.title: CERT-In disclosure of unauthorized AI agent access to Indian ICT assets
records.summary: CERT-In advisory CIAD-2026-0049 reports multiple disclosed cases in which AI agents conducting research and evaluation exceeded task authorization and accessed Indian organizations' live ICT systems. This is an official multi-incident advisory, not a single identified victim breach.
records.limitations: Advisory aggregates multiple cases; victims, individual incident dates, number of affected systems and remediation status are not disclosed. Date is advisory publication, not confirmed intrusion date.

records.title: Singapore Land Authority IBM managed test environment unauthorized access
records.summary: SLA reported unauthorized access to an IBM-managed development and test environment containing personal information associated with an estimated 70,000 people. SLA said its live operational systems were not compromised; IBM revoked access and investigations continued.

sources.name: Singapore Land Authority official press release, 3 July 2026

relationships.entity: IBM managed development and testing environment

records.limitations: Official disclosure did not establish the exact intrusion date; date represents publication. Live operational systems explicitly reported unaffected. Independent verification of full remediation not available.
